# Globe Skillz

> Shopify SEO studio with development built in, led by Saqib Ali (since 2019). Serves Shopify merchants worldwide, including the US, UK, EU, Gulf, Australia and Pakistan.

## Shopify SEO services
- [Shopify SEO Services](https://globeskillz.com/services/shopify-seo.html): Monthly Shopify SEO run by a developer who reads Liquid: technical fixes, collection and product optimization, content and links. Serving merchants worldwide.
- [Shopify SEO Audit](https://globeskillz.com/services/shopify-seo-audit.html): A manual Shopify SEO audit covering crawl, indexation, theme code, Core Web Vitals, content and links. You get a prioritized fix list you can actually act on.
- [Shopify Technical SEO](https://globeskillz.com/services/shopify-technical-seo.html): Technical SEO for Shopify, fixed directly in your theme: duplicate URLs, faceted navigation, robots.txt.liquid, structured data, sitemaps and Core Web Vitals.
- [Collection & Product SEO](https://globeskillz.com/services/shopify-on-page-seo.html): On-page SEO for Shopify collection and product pages: keyword mapping, titles, descriptions, collection copy, FAQs, internal links and rich results.
- [Shopify Content SEO](https://globeskillz.com/services/shopify-content-seo.html): Content strategy and writing for Shopify stores: topic clusters, buying guides and comparison articles, each linked to the collections they support.
- [Shopify Link Building](https://globeskillz.com/services/shopify-link-building.html): White-hat link building for Shopify stores: digital PR, supplier and partner links, resource placements and unlinked brand mentions. No PBNs and no link farms.
- [International Shopify SEO](https://globeskillz.com/services/shopify-international-seo.html): SEO for Shopify stores selling across borders: Shopify Markets setup, hreflang, subfolders and domains, localized keyword research and country-level content.
- [AI Search Optimization](https://globeskillz.com/services/shopify-ai-search-optimization.html): Help your Shopify store appear in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity answers with entity clarity, structured data and quotable content.

## Shopify development services
- [Shopify Store Development](https://globeskillz.com/services/shopify-development.html): Shopify store design and development with SEO built in from the start: clean Liquid, fast templates, correct schema and a site structure planned around search.
- [Theme Customization & Liquid](https://globeskillz.com/services/shopify-theme-customization.html): Custom Shopify sections, Liquid development, theme bug fixes and feature builds. Clean code that won’t hurt speed or SEO.
- [Shopify Speed Optimization](https://globeskillz.com/services/shopify-speed-optimization.html): Make your Shopify store faster and pass Core Web Vitals: LCP, INP and CLS fixes, app script cleanup, image delivery and theme-level performance work.
- [Migration to Shopify (SEO-Safe)](https://globeskillz.com/services/shopify-migration.html): Move to Shopify from WooCommerce, Wix, Squarespace, BigCommerce or Magento without losing rankings: URL mapping, 301s, data migration, monitoring.
- [Shopify Maintenance & Support](https://globeskillz.com/services/shopify-maintenance-support.html): Monthly Shopify development support: bug fixes, small features, theme updates, app QA and SEO-safe changes from a developer you can reach on WhatsApp.
